title: Return, O Wanderer, Return
description: Return, O Wanderer, Return in Tonic Solfa to OLD HUNDREDTH, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: William Bengo Collyer wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 54.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to OLD HUNDREDTH; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Re-turn, O wan-der-er, re-turn And seek an in-jured Fa-ther’s face; Those warm de-sires that in thee burn Were kin-dled by re-claim-ing grace.

lines: And seek an injured Father’s face;
Those warm desires that in thee burn
And seek a Father’s melting heart;
His pitying eyes thy grief discern,
His hand shall heal thine inward smart.
Thy Savior bids thy spirit live;
Go to His bleeding feet and learn
And wipe away the falling tear;

licence: Public domain: William Bengo Collyer died in 1854.
credits: Words by William Bengo Collyer (1782–1854), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to OLD HUNDREDTH by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
